info.title: Submerge Crystal API v1
info.description:
REST API for Submerge Crystal, the core indexer component of Submerge.

Submerge API endpoints are grouped under five resource sets:
- Blocks
- Calls
- Events
- Extrinsics
- Genesis
- Metadata
- Traces

Public API is limited by 5 requests per second.
Request query parameters use `snake_case`; response fields use `camelCase`.

servers.description: API preview deployment for Polkadot Coretime.
Submerge Crystal production API per deployed chain.

get.description: Returns all blocks from the database that satisfy the query parameters. It will return a paginated response, ordered descending by block number.

parameters.description: Block list page number to retrieve. 1-indexed.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of blocks per page to be returned.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter results by block status. If not specified, all blocks are returned.

parameters.name: min_block_number
parameters.description: Filter blocks by minimum block number.

parameters.name: max_block_number
parameters.description: Filter blocks by maximum block number.

parameters.name: min_block_timestamp
parameters.description: Filter blocks by minimum block timestamp. In milliseconds.

parameters.name: max_block_timestamp
parameters.description: Filter blocks by maximum block timestamp. In milliseconds.

parameters.name: min_spec_version
parameters.description: Filter blocks by minimum runtime spec version.

parameters.name: max_spec_version
parameters.description: Filter blocks by maximum runtime spec version.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description:
Filter results by block author. Either of the following:
- Author's Substrate SS58 address string (e.g. `5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY`).
- Author's Substrate account id encoded as a hexadecimal string (e.g. `0x008d8404893c7b4b80f397605cc96e61fec3c89676c8c2794a2a7d281d678b1a`).
- Author's address encoded as a hexadecimal string with optional `0x` prefix (e.g. `0x008d8404893c7b4b80f397605cc96e61fec3c89676c8c2794a2a7d281d678b1a`).

BlockStatus.description:
Block status.
- `finalized`: Blocks that have been finalized on chain.
- `proposed`: Blocks that have been authored but not yet finalized.
- `pruned`: Blocks that have been removed or are no longer accessible.

and ECDSA (65 bytes → 130 hex chars). **Always** `0x`-prefixed and lowercase in responses.
Inputs elsewhere may accept mixed case or missing `0x`; the API normalizes outputs.

Trace.description: A trace record in a block.

extId.description: ExtId value for the trace record.

hash.description: Artificial hash of the trace (`sha256(block_hash || index)`).

index.description: Index of the trace within the block.

keyParams.description:
Substrate storage parameters appended to the end of the storage key,
if the storage item has parameters.

keyPrefix.description: Substrate storage key prefix of the trace record.

knownKey.description: If the trace record is for a known UTF-8 key, the string representation of the key.

palletIndex.description: If the trace record is a storage item, the storage item's pallet index in the metadata.

palletName.description: If the trace record is a storage item, the storage item's pallet name in the metadata.

palletStorageItemIndex.description: If the trace record is a storage item, the storage item's index in the pallet metadata.

palletStorageItemName.description: If the trace record is a storage item, the storage item's name.

specVersion.description: Runtime spec version of the call's block.

MetadataPalletStorageItemList.description: All storage items in a pallet.

MetadataPalletSummaryList.description: List of summaries of matching metadata pallets.

PaginatedGenesisRecordList.description: Paginated list of genesis record items.

PaginatedMetadataList.description: Response with a paginated list of metadata summaries.
